comment: Lectures were super helpful and interactive. She explains everything very well

Clear grading criteria. Lets you retake missed problems on exams and the final doesn't count for as much. Overall an easy class and she is highly accessible outside of class. If you have Dr. Hoke, you are in good hands!

She is an outstanding professor. Some math professors at UR fail to recognize that this is a general education requirement for a liberal arts curriculum. There is nothing "liberal" about taking pride in teaching for a purely math-brained audience. When I took Dr. Hoke's class, I was engaged, consistently participated, and researched beyond class.

Dr. Hoke is the best math teacher I've had at U of R. She truly cares and is always there to support you if you have any questions. She offers revisions, and her priority is always ensuring you understand the content. The homework assignments are relatively straightforward and always mimic what you will need to know for the tests/quizzes.

dr. hoke is the best! shes so sweet and caring and gives everyone the best opportunity to succeed. had her for math 102 (finite math) and it was the easiest class i had. homework usually after every class but it took 10-15 minutes. little use of textbook and we get cheat sheets on every test (including the final). as long as u pay attention ur good
So well versed in the world of maths
One of the best profs at UR
She is nice, but she makes things more confusing than they need to be. She's pretty lenient about retakes and will see you outside of class if needed

Math 300: Dr. Hoke is the best math professor I've ever had. She has problems to do on the board, and if you are struggling, she approaches you to help. She provides timely feedback and many chances for you to earn points back lost from tests/quizzes. She wants you to learn and devotes a lot of her time to this class. She makes me love math again.

Dr. Hoke is very nice. Tons of chances for you to improve your grades. You can redo the skills quizzes as many times as you want and also redo one test question if your test score is below an A. I also love her teaching style, which is to make students figure out their mistakes on their own or with her patient guidance. Highly recommend!

Dr Hoke is very kind and you can genuinely tell she cares about her students. Calc isn't the easiest of subjects but I honestly don't know if I could have taken it with anyone else. Her class was set up for students to succeed and tests were very fair. The homeworks were relatively hard but she allowed for some failures on them in the grading.

She really cares about the final answer especially with the " mastery grading system" I would not recommend
When I tried to get help, it was not helpful
Also sometimes she would not be straightforward with what she wants

Dr Hoke is very sweet. In class, she will teach the material and then you have to do the practice problems on the board. She is always willing to help out of class. If you're struggling go to office hours, and she will help you. I wasn't the best with Cal but she was always very supportive. Don't wait until the last minute to seek help!

Dr. Hoke is my favorite teacher at UR. Both her lectures & discussion sessions are extremely helpful. She offers a lot of help both inside and outside class. She never judges your questions even if they are really dumb. She also cares a lot about details in your homework and tests, and would even correct your scratch work.

Dr. Hoke is such an incredible professor. Her attitude and the classroom atmosphere make everyone feel comfortable to ask questions without feeling dumb. She always goes beyond her duty by having review sessions and exam preparations to make sure everyone understands the material. Dr. Hoke is extremely caring: once she offered her help at 22:30.

Dr. Hoke is THE best. Honestly, she is so nice and teaches so well that makes you care about the class and her. I took the SMART course and never had Calculus before. Nevertheless, her classes and exams (checkpoints) were relatively easy, and you have up to 4 chances to master 2 learning objectives -- so it's almost impossible not getting an A.

Absolute QUEEN. If you're dreading taking a math course to satisfy your gen-ed, take her. I hate math but I would 100% take her course again. She is very accessible outside of class, and genuinely wants you to succeed. Class can move a little fast, but she is very flexible with grading and she holds reviews before each exam.

If you have the chance to take a class with Dr. Hoke, DO IT! She is one of my favorite professors because her class is centered around student engagement and success. All of her assessments reflect what you cover in class and she gives you the opportunity to get credit for things you might have missed because she genuinely wants everyone to succeed

I hated this class. She is not helpful at all and she gets frustrated when you dont understand after a while. Im not sure where people are getting the positive experiences from but she was not anything like this to me. I am a hardworking student but I still did not understand anything in the class.

Dr. Hoke is by far one of the best professors at UR!! (Honestly my favorite) Shes very sweet and truly cares about her students. The work she assigns is very manageable and she gives old tests as practice for exams so you know exactly what to expect and study. Honestly, if you put in the work and show up to class, youll likely get an A

Math 211 If you have a chance to take a class with Dr. Hoke, don't think twice about it. She is one of the best teachers I have ever had and was always there when I needed help. She has made me love calculus after having previously struggled with it.

Kathy is a great professor - she made class really easy and was always available for questions. Very clear lectures, she gives you previous tests and then her exams are basically the same exact format and types of questions. A lot of people do well though, which makes an A harder to get (usually 94+). I never took calc/pre calc and still got all As
Take this professor. Very easy course and very nice lady.

Kathy is one of the best math professors at UR!!! Her lectures are very clear, especially for people who just take Calculus to satisfy general education requirements and math is not their hing!! She also has 3 cool projects to apply calculus on real life cases that truly taught me a lot!! If you have Kathy, you're so lucky!!!

She genuinely cares about how well you learn the material. There is always a review session before a test and if you don't do well on a test or quiz, she emails you to think about visiting her during office hours so you can better understand the material.

I struggled throughout this course, but Professor Hoke was one of the best professors I have ever had. She was always very helpful during her office hours and she went out of her way to hold review sessions before exams. Her positive attitude encouraged learning and reminded me to keep trying even when things got difficult. Very easy to get an A.

She moves pretty fast, has an incredibly thick southern accent, and posts student solutions to homeworks rather than posting her own solutions. Half the time they're not even right and it's impossible to learn off of. Tests are fair, study the homeworks.

She is a great math teacher. She goes a little too fast at times, but generally allows you to catch up. She is always available outside of class to assist you and will not let you leave until you really understand the material. her tests are fair. She is not out to trick you in any way, but just trying to make sure you are  learning the material.
Professor Hoke is very helpful outside of class and tested on general information. The course was pretty easy for such a hard topic to teach. She is fair and really wants her students to do well.
I had her for both Calc 1 and 2. She takes a tough subject and works with you until you know it. If you take the time to go see her, it will pay off big time. Excellent teacher
She knows her stuff and cares about the student.  Class is definately challenging, but she'll work with you as hard as you will to get the best grade possible.
